steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation required by the case.
Allow participants to be added during event creation so publishing is possible.
Provide the required event title.
Create the required Technical plus RFQ stage combination.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the line item to be quoted.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the required 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor for the vendor-side acceptance and quote.
Publish the completed two-stage event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited vendor's separate supplier session.
Open the Technical stage where the clauses should be presented.
Verify the required Technical-stage clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the optional Technical-stage clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept the required clause.
Accept the optional clause.
Submit the vendor's technical response after accepting both clauses.
Confirm the technical response was submitted.
Open the RFQ pricing stage to verify the vendor is not asked for the Technical-stage clauses.
Confirm the required Technical-stage clause is not requested on RFQ.
Confirm the optional Technical-stage clause is not requested on RFQ.
Quote 100 for the RFQ line item and submit the vendor bid.
Assert that the vendor's RFQ bid was accepted.
Return to the buyer session for the final response assertion.
Confirm the buyer sees the vendor's submitted RFQ response.
